# SaveTowards

> SaveTowards is a free web app that turns a savings goal and target date into a simple, actionable savings rate — how much to set aside per day, week, month, or paycheck to get there on time.

SaveTowards is for anyone with a savings goal (a trip, a gift, an emergency fund, a big purchase) who wants a clear number to act on, not a budgeting or investment tool. There is no interest or inflation modeling — just straightforward division of the amount remaining by the time remaining.

Key facts:
- Free to use, no account or sign-up required.
- All data is stored locally in the user's browser (localStorage). Nothing is sent to a server or shared with third parties.
- No backend, no database, no authentication.
- Users can track multiple goals at once, each with its own target amount, target date, and progress visualization.
- The core output is a single headline number (e.g. "$47/week") with an optional breakdown by day, week, month, and pay period.

## Pages

- [SaveTowards](https://savetowards.com/): The app itself. Single page — create a goal, see your required savings rate, and track progress toward it.

## Calculators

Each of these is a standalone page with its own explanation and an embedded calculator for that specific goal. All use the same simple division math (amount remaining / time remaining) and store nothing on a server.

- [Savings goal calculator](https://savetowards.com/savings-goal-calculator): How much to save per day, week, month, or paycheck for any goal by a target date.
- [How much to save per paycheck](https://savetowards.com/how-much-to-save-per-paycheck): The share of each paycheck to set aside, for weekly, biweekly, or monthly pay.
- [Vacation savings calculator](https://savetowards.com/vacation-savings-calculator): Save a trip's cost by your travel date.
- [Wedding savings calculator](https://savetowards.com/wedding-savings-calculator): Save a wedding budget by the date, split between two people if needed.
- [Baby savings calculator](https://savetowards.com/baby-savings-calculator): Save upfront baby costs before the due date.
- [College savings calculator](https://savetowards.com/college-savings-calculator): Save a chosen share of college costs by the year it starts.
- [Emergency fund calculator](https://savetowards.com/emergency-fund-calculator): Build three to six months of expenses by a chosen date.
- [House down payment savings calculator](https://savetowards.com/house-down-payment-savings-calculator): Save a down payment (and closing costs) by your target buy date.
- [Car savings calculator](https://savetowards.com/car-savings-calculator): Save a car's price or down payment by a target date.
- [Christmas savings calculator](https://savetowards.com/christmas-savings-calculator): Save your holiday spending total before December.
